newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's Salhia expects mid-year net rise.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's Salhia expects mid-year net rise.

text.p: Kuwait Salhia Real Estate Co 1997 first half net profit is expected to exceed five million dinars ($16.6 million) compared with 3.3 million in the same period of 1996, a company official said on Monday.
"It is expected that the company's net profit for the first half (calendar 1997) would be above five million dinars," the official who asked not to be identified told Reuters by telephone.
Salhia, established in 1974, reported a net profit of eight million dinars in 1996, a rise of 61 percent compared with 1995.
Salhia has formed an eight-year 50/50 joint venture with Britain's St Modwen Properties Plc to invest up to 100 million stg in British investment property.
Salhia's capital share would be 12.5 million stg in the joint venture called Key Property Investment Ltd.
"We are trying to expand gradually and carefully, in a very conservative way," the Salhia official said.

The company, whose domestic assets make about 77 percent of its total real estate assets, plans to balance domestic and foreign assets through expanding in "politically and economically stable countries," he said.
Salhia, which owns and runs property in Kuwait and Germany, also invests in equity.
